2608.25756.title: TailSFT: Filtered Fine-Tuning Improves Post-Training Performance
2608.25756.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning post-training drives reasoning and agentic capabilities in modern AI systems, yet a growing body of work shows that it is most effective when used to fine-tune an already capable base model. We question whether existing pipelines yield models that are most suitable for reinforcement learning. Building on prior work highlighting the role of coverage and pass@K as predictors of post-RL performance, we design a simple modification to supervised fine-tuning, TailSFT, which filters out already fit sequences during training, thereby focusing learning on under-modeled regions, or the tail, of the data distribution. We justify and validate the design choices in TailSFT, particularly the specific filtering criteria, through a combination of controlled experiments and theoretical analysis. On OLMo-3 7B, TailSFT often improves pass@16 performance on math and coding evaluations, with gains up to 17% absolute, while incurring minimal computational overhead. These higher-coverage checkpoints consistently translate to up to 4% absolute pass@1 gains in subsequent GRPO runs, demonstrating that TailSFT checkpoints serve as better initializations for RL. We further introduce a lightweight diagnostic for identifying settings where TailSFT is most likely to help. More broadly, our results motivate a principled, stage-aware approach to model development, in which intermediate checkpoints are judged by how effectively they support subsequent training.
2608.25756.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習後訓練推動了現代 AI 系統的推理和代理能力，但越來越多的研究顯示，當用於微調已具備能力的基礎模型時，其效果最佳。我們質疑現有的流程是否能產出最適合強化學習的模型。基於之前的研究，強調了覆蓋率和 pass@K 作為後強化學習表現的預測指標，我們設計了一個簡單的監督微調修改，TailSFT，該方法在訓練過程中過濾掉已經適合的序列，從而將學習重點放在數據分佈的欠建模區域，或稱為尾部。我們通過受控實驗和理論分析的結合，為 TailSFT 的設計選擇，特別是具體的過濾標準，提供了合理性和驗證。在 OLMo-3 7B 上，TailSFT 通常能提升數學和編碼評估中的 pass@16 表現，增幅高達 17% 的絕對值，同時產生的計算開銷極小。這些高覆蓋率的檢查點在隨後的 GRPO 執行中，持續轉化為高達 4% 的絕對 pass@1 增益，證明 TailSFT 檢查點作為強化學習的更佳初始化。我們進一步介紹了一個輕量級診斷工具，用於識別 TailSFT 最有可能提供幫助的設置。更廣泛地說，我們的結果促進了一種原則性、階段意識的模型開發方法，其中中間檢查點的評價基於它們對後續訓練的支持效果。
